headline: You can now pick which booking links show on your Google profile
dek: Google added a self-serve control on November 23 that lets Business Profile owners turn third-party appointment and dining reservation links off and back on. Google's Lisa Landsman said it covers salons, clinics, fitness studios, local service businesses and restaurants. It matches a control for restaurant delivery links that arrived a few weeks earlier, and Google did not say which regions get it.
why: An old booking partner left on your profile can send a ready customer to a calendar nobody checks anymore, which is an easy way to lose a holiday appointment.
doThis: Open the Booking section of your profile this week, turn off any partner you no longer use, then tap the remaining booking button on your phone to make sure it opens your live scheduler.
